component.name: HomeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.top.backgroundURI = "" m.top.backgroundColor = "#0A0A0A"
' Title bar m.title = m.top.findNode("titleLabel") m.status = m.top.findNode("statusLabel")
' Channel grid m.channelList = m.top.findNode("channelList") m.channelList.observeField("itemSelected", "onChannelSelected") m.channelList.setFocus(true)
' Load channels from backend m.backendBase = "https://broadcaster.emergent.host" loadChannels() end sub
sub loadChannels() m.status.text = "Loading channels..." data = httpGetJson(m.backendBase + "/api/channels") if data = invalid m.status.text = "Unable to load channels. Check your connection." return end if
content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.channels = [] for each ch in data if ch.videos <> invalid and ch.videos.Count() > 0 m.channels.Push(ch) item = content.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = ch.name item.description = (ch.videos.Count()).ToStr() + " videos" if ch.icon <> invalid and Len(ch.icon) > 0 item.HDPosterUrl = ch.icon item.SDPosterUrl = ch.icon end if end if end for m.channelList.content = content m.status.text = "Select a channel to start watching" end sub
sub onChannelSelected() idx = m.channelList.itemSelected if idx < 0 or idx >= m.channels.Count() then return channel = m.channels[idx]
' Open the live player player = m.top.createChild("LivePlayer") player.channel = channel player.backendBase = m.backendBase player.setFocus(true) player.observeField("closed", "onPlayerClosed") end sub
sub onPlayerClosed() ' Return focus to grid m.channelList.setFocus(true) for i = m.top.getChildCount() - 1 to 0 step -1 child = m.top.getChild(i) if child.subtype() = "LivePlayer" m.top.removeChild(child) end if end for end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if press and key = "back" m.top.exit = true return true end if return false end function
